exposure: history of high risk for preterm birth
cohort: 195 singleton pregnancies at low or high risk for preterm birth, evaluated between 16th and 26th weeks of gestation.
finding: Amniotic fluid sludge (AFS) was found to be an independent risk factor for preterm delivery before 35 weeks.
gest_age: Participants were evaluated between 16th and 26th weeks; outcomes were defined as preterm delivery before 28, 32, 35, and 37 weeks.
